reported.title: No debounce: bounce and release edges toggle lamp multiple times per press
reported.description: The loop at lines 50-56 reads the raw pin and calls flipLamp() on every HIGH-to-LOW transition with no settle/debounce window, so each bounce edge during a press counts as a new press. Measured evidence: bounce scenario gave toggle counts [4,4,4,4] per press and rapid presses gave [3,3,3,...], and the long-hold scenario gave 7 toggles for one press. The spec requires a 40 ms settle window before accepting a press edge, which is entirely absent. 4 of 4 press(es) did not toggle D11 exactly once; toggle counts per press were [4, 4, 4, 4]. D11 also toggled 12 time(s) with no press to explain it, first at 1.40 s.

judge_input.spec:
- Momentary wall switch on D5 to ground with internal pull-up (active LOW); foyer lamp driver on D11.
- Each settled press toggles the lamp exactly once within 150 ms; releasing the switch must not toggle.
- Contact bounce up to 20 ms on press and release must not produce extra toggles.
- Debounce / settle window of 40 ms before accepting a press edge.
- Every 1500 ms print `foyer lamp=ON` or `foyer lamp=OFF`.
- Idle (unpressed) switch reads HIGH; a physical press is a HIGH-to-LOW transition after settle.
